observations.finding: Both soft and athletic female swim jab closeups show a large dark oval in the inner upper arm. Direct RGB comparison establishes that this oval is textile-colored, not background showing through. The initial hole interpretation was incorrect. The generator bathing_suit applies x±.177/y<=1.285 rectangular clipping without arm ownership, so covered inner-arm polygons are moved to textile. Exact material/triangle diagnosis is being independently measured by original_character.
observations.source_region: tools/authored_character/build_seoul_resident.py bathing_suit lines778-818 in frozen body01 source
observations.geometry_collapse_status: Not established; do not infer a hole, flattened volume or failed LBS merely from the dark patch. Root/original/combat reviewers corrected this inference before production changes. A preliminary single-surface radial fixture was invalid because it excluded the textile arm patch from the source tube.

observations.finding: All15 jab/cross/hook hand closeups now have attached thumb bases and closed fingers. The old long downward detached-stick thumb is not observed. Knuckles/thumb tips remain coarse and square; not photorealistic.

16 ordered combat sheets show neutral→windup→face-height guard→extended punch/bent hook→recoil→neutral, with pelvis/shoulder change and bent knees. Feet remain near the support plane; no obvious whole-body teleport is visible in sampled frames. Still images do not prove continuous-time comfort or shoe support under all city terrain.

Street folded arms retain small bright/creased armpit patches; broad shoulders, sleeve ends and fists remain simplified. Final eye surfaces no longer visibly float forward like glasses in the reviewed closeups, but eyes/head/hair remain stylized prototype geometry.

12 gait sheets cover selected front/back/left/rear-hip samples in all6 gender/profile runs. Alternating legs, opposite arm swings, hip shifts and distinct walk/run reach are visible; no giant blades or detached pelvis/legs observed in these selected street frames. Soft waist/hip changes are visible versus standard; athletic shoulder/torso changes are subtler through clothes. Shape differences do not establish natural human anatomy.

Running palms stay rather flat/open and face up/out in side views. Upper body is upright/stiff and posterior trouser folds are broad/simple. These are retained authored gait style limits; do not call the result GTA-quality or finished realistic motion.
